I have noticed a trend on Voat where many users will create their own subverses for their own interests. I like this idea. I started v/JustGrowIt because I love gardening an noticed the gardening sub was slim. I started v/SavageGods because I loved world building, I had to hand the reigns over because I could not put the care and attention I wanted into it. Now I have started v/ThePath to explore another topic that has always interested me - enlightenment and spirituality.

Now I know the general feel of Voat. I'm sure many would consider my ideas on the topic as idealistic or new age bullshit founded on nothing. You very well may be right, and I respect your opinion. But I have always been obsessed with the occult, pagan religions, mythology, and in recent years - enlightenment. I hope to capture all these in one subverse. I took over v/Taoism, and while I love the Tao, I feel it is just a piece to the grand puzzle.

There is a lot of hate and negativity here. A lot of the topics center around who we hate and why we hate them. I don't like this feeling. SJWs, Feminists, Gays, Muslims, Fatties, etc. Even if some of these groups, in your eyes, deserve hate - I don't think that comes with a solution. I truly feel that if we can spread compassion, critical thinking, philosophy, questioning of all authority, and more important than all others - thinking for one's self, I do feel we can make this world (or at least our worlds) a better place.

As always, thank you for hearing me.
